title: [smime-tree] Add AuthEnvelopedData (AES-GCM) encrypt/decrypt support
description: encrypt() should produce AuthEnvelopedData (RFC 5083) with AES-GCM instead of EnvelopedData with AES-CBC. decrypt() should accept both AuthEnvelopedData (GCM) and EnvelopedData (CBC, for legacy interop). This eliminates the unauthenticated CBC risk documented in MIME-8zt.3.
close_reason: encrypt() produces AuthEnvelopedData with AES-GCM. decrypt() accepts both GCM and legacy CBC. 2 new roundtrip tests.
